tasks.title: Step-up token issue+verify + wire revokeDevice
tasks.note: merged; R2 security APPROVED (6 attacks probed+blocked); micro-fix: broke latent import cycle (lazy hash import). 116 tests all gates PASS
tasks.description: READ .softhouse/mfa-stepup-brief.md IN FULL. Forks from main AFTER T1 (uses the mfa_factor model + TOTP verify). Build STEP-UP (highest risk — the backend issues a credential): (a) new `step_up_token` model + 0001 migration LOCKSTEP (token_hash, member_id, requested_action nullable, expires_at, consumed_at nullable). (b) createStepUpToken (POST /auth/step-up, 200 StepUpResponse{step_up_token, expires_at}) on get_current_member: verify `factor_response` (TOTP code, ±1 step window only, constant-time) against the member's ACTIVE factor; on success mint an OPAQUE random step_up_token (store only its HASH), short-lived (few min), bound to the member (+ requested_action if given); on repeated failure LOCKOUT -> 423. Also activate a PENDING factor on first correct code if that is the chosen binding (per T1). (c) `require_step_up` FastAPI dependency: read X-Step-Up-Token, verify (exists + unexpired + NOT consumed + belongs to get_current_member; requested_action matches if set) then CONSUME it (single-use — a replay fails), else 401/403. (d) WIRE revokeDevice (DELETE /auth/devices/{id}, memberOAuth2 + require_step_up): mount it, IDOR-safe (a member revokes only THEIR device — 404 for another member's id, never by-id cross-member), and ADD it to the test_health route allowlist (now expected). NO money/ledger. Tests backend/tests/test_stepup.py: enroll->confirm->step-up happy path; wrong code -> rejected; N failures -> 423 lockout; step-up token SINGLE-USE (2nd use fails); EXPIRED token rejected; token for A rejected for B (binding); revokeDevice WITHOUT step-up -> 401/403, WITH -> 200; revokeDevice IDOR (A can't revoke B's device). GATES from backend/ ALL PASS (paste): check_models, check_migration (lockstep), openapi/validate.py, pytest; ruff+mypy strict clean. Handoff: the step-up token design (single-use/expiry/binding/lockout), the TOTP window, require_step_up, the revokeDevice wiring+IDOR, which attack each test proves, gate outputs.
